title: Scrap Yard - Mini Mod
description: A way to bring some extra uses to those under-used items.
body:
NOTICE -=- This mod is in development, so elements are, and most likely will be, subject to change. As of 0.1, all of the textures are currently placeholders, not the final version.

Scrapyard is a small, lightweight, Minecraft mod that aims to help the under-used items of the game, by bringing some new uses to the table. The primary additions of the mod are the new Scrap Compactor block, the Scrapper villager profession, and the Scrap block.

Additions :
Scrap Compactor -=- The Scrap Compactor lets you take four of any non-Scrap item, and compact it into Scrap. The Scrap Compactor can be either crafted or bought from a Scrapper villager.

Scrapper Villager Profession -=- The new Scrapper villager profession comes with a new dedicated structure and two new trades. The Scrapper can be found in his Scrapper House, found throughout the world. His two new trades allow you to sell him Scrap and buy the Scrap Compactor.

Scrapper House -=- This small new structure generates throughout the world in a few of the same biomes as villages. The Scrapper naturally spawns here and it even comes with a Scrap Compactor inside.

New Blocks -=- This mod comes with a few new blocks to play around with. These are, the Rusted Iron Door, the Rusted Iron Trapdoor, the Scrap block, and the Mesh Fence.
